verdict: BOUND, gate FAIL. A per-pose oracle K (every check of the model on every sample, legal configurations only) moves the k33 frozen exact Bench(110,360) gap 18.61 -> 16.96 static / 17.25 connected (plain), 21.46 near-touch: +3 ws takes (148, 316, 369) and nothing else. Five binders (117 / 119 / 129 ER, 343 / 423 IR) and 405 / 459 touch the skin at EVERY legal K. The anterior link-2 corridor buys no oracle points on Bench(60,160) (+8 deg: 13.73 near vs 11.18 at route 0). Any K law, spring, stop or sensed K at these seats is bounded by 17.25 plain / 21.46 near-touch.
limiter: metal parking at the ER binders (plane -90..-45, elev 45-60, axial 120-135): they want LESS K and still touch at the 5.5-deg floor (117 -1.14, 129 -5.87 with K >= 66 refused by the knee slide, 119 -10.74); the IR binders want K at stop B (82) and 343 / 423 still touch there (-0.19 / -1.33). The K self-motion cannot move hub 2 / link 2 off the skin at these seats - the wall is seat-level (where hub 2 and link 2 park), not K-level.
